# CBGG - Crop Breeding and Genetics Journal

> An open-access peer-reviewed journal dedicated to advancing crop breeding, genetics, and genomics research for sustainable agriculture and global food security.

CBGG is published by Hapres and serves as a platform for disseminating cutting-edge research in crop improvement, plant genetics, and breeding strategies. The journal features research articles, special issues on climate-resilient agriculture, and contributions from leading international agricultural research institutions.

## Key Topics

- Crop Breeding
- Genetics and Genomics
- Plant Genetics
- Genetic Gains
- Food Security
- Open Access Publishing
- Peer Review
- Manuscript Submission
- Agricultural Research
- Climate-Resilient Crops
- Crop Improvement
- Plant Breeding
- Genomic Selection
- Interspecific Hybridization
- Hapres Academic Publisher

## Journal Overview

- [CBGG Homepage](https://cbgg.hapres.com): Main landing page for CBGG open access journal on crop breeding and genomics
- [About the Journal](https://cbgg.hapres.com/CBGG_AboutTheJournal.aspx): Journal scope, mission, and peer-review standards for CBGG
- [Article Collections](https://cbgg.hapres.com/ArticleListST.aspx): Searchable listings of peer-reviewed manuscripts and published articles
- [Editorial Board](https://cbgg.hapres.com/EditorialBoard.aspx): CBGG editorial board members and leadership information

## Author Resources

- [Guide for Authors](https://cbgg.hapres.com/CBGG_GuideforAuthors.aspx): Comprehensive author guidelines, manuscript formatting, and publication policies
- [Online Manuscript Submission](https://cbgg.hapres.com/CBGG_OnlineSubmission.aspx): CBGG online submission system and step-by-step author guidelines for manuscript uploads
- [Article Processing Charges](https://cbgg.hapres.com/CBGG_ArticleProcessingCharges.aspx): Publication fee information and payment details for open access articles
- [Journal Contact Information](https://cbgg.hapres.com/CBGG_JournalContactInformation.aspx): Editorial office contact details and journal correspondence information

## Special Issues

- [Special Issues Overview](https://cbgg.hapres.com/SpecialIssues.aspx): Virtual special issues on genetics, genomics, and climate resilience in crop breeding
- [Genetic Gains in Plant Breeding](https://cbgg.hapres.com/SpecialIssuesGGPB.aspx): Special issue on genetic gains in plant breeding for sustainable development
- [Climate-Resilient Crop Breeding](https://cbgg.hapres.com/SpecialIssuesSI.aspx): Special issue on genetics and genomics for climate-resilient crop breeding strategies

## Featured Research Articles

- [Genetic Gains in Wheat Breeding and Its Role in Feeding the World](https://cbgg.hapres.com/htmls/CBGG_1052_Detail.html): Review of wheat breeding strategies, genetic gains, and global food security impacts
- [Interspecific Hybridization for Brassica Crop Improvement](https://cbgg.hapres.com/htmls/CBGG_1055_Detail.html): Review of interspecific hybridization methods and resources for Brassica crop improvement
- [Excellence in Cassava Breeding: Perspectives for the Future](https://cbgg.hapres.com/htmls/CBGG_1209_Detail.html): Cassava breeding progress, genetic gains strategies, and trait introgression approaches
- [Wheat Production and Breeding in Ethiopia: Retrospect and Prospects](https://cbgg.hapres.com/htmls/CBGG_1490_Detail.html): Ethiopia wheat production status, breeding progress, and future prospects for food security
- [Genome-Wide Identification and Validation of Septoria Tritici Blotch Resistance Alleles in Elite Winter Wheat Germplasm](https://cbgg.hapres.com/htmls/CBGG_1874_Detail.html): GWAS study identifying wheat resistance markers to Septoria tritici blotch disease
